assign-pick-*: design 2a (pass-2 review): 'Use in a repo…' has ONE way to choose — the project select — so the per-row 'Use here' button is gone (the same list keeps its read-only 'storefront pins r2 (newest)' line); the choice is assign-project-select + assign-repo-select and the verb is assign-confirm
studio-header-runs: design 1g: Studio header drops the Runs/Assigned affordances (Workflows Review handoff)
studio-header-assigned: design 1g: Studio header drops the Runs/Assigned affordances (Workflows Review handoff)
workflow-duplicate-*: re-homed to RowMenu.testidFor() by the library-row-menu worker; ids still exist at runtime and are asserted by tests, but the static check only sees literal data-testid templates
workflow-move-folder-*: re-homed to RowMenu.testidFor() by the library-row-menu worker; ids still exist at runtime and are asserted by tests, but the static check only sees literal data-testid templates
canvas-minimap-toggle: design 1g: the React Flow default Controls/Map toggle were replaced by the compact '− + fit' canvas-controls group (canvas-zoom-in/-out/canvas-fit); the minimap itself was dropped with it
library-new-pipeline: design 1b/1c: the inline NEW PIPELINE form is gone — creation is the New workflow dialog (new-workflow-dialog / new-workflow-form) opened by workflows-new-workflow or a workflow-starter-* card; the fields it kept under the same names are library-new-name-input, library-new-slug-input (behind new-workflow-id-change) and library-new-submit
library-new-template-failure: design 1b/1c: the inline form's 'template draft was not created' banner is gone; the same failure state is the New workflow dialog's own seedFailure line (template-use-draft-failure, plus new-workflow-folder-failure for the folder PATCH)
library-new-template-retry: design 1b/1c: the inline form's 'Retry the template draft' button is gone; the dialog's own retry is template-use-draft-retry
library-templates: design 1b: the bottom STARTER WORKFLOWS panel is gone — the three starter cards above the list (workflow-starter-blank / workflow-starter-<template id>) are its replacement, and each click opens the New workflow dialog with that starter preselected
library-templates-note: design 1b: the STARTER WORKFLOWS panel's one-line note is gone; the cards state their own step count and the read-only reason is workflow-starters-need-role
library-template-*: design 1b: the panel's per-template rows (library-template-<id>, plus the library-template-<id>-needs-role line) are gone — replaced by the starter cards workflow-starter-<id> and the dialog's starter cards new-workflow-template-<id>
template-*: design 1b: the panel's per-template 'Use template' buttons and step counts (template-<id>-use, template-<id>-steps) are gone; a starter is now chosen as a card (new-workflow-template-<id>) and created by library-new-submit. The dialog keeps template-use-pipeline-failure and template-use-draft-retry under those same names
template-use-draft-failure: design 1c: still rendered by NewWorkflowDialog, but its data-testid is now computed by a ternary ('new-workflow-folder-failure' | 'template-use-draft-failure'), so the static scan cannot see the literal — nothing was renamed or removed at runtime
workflow-draft-*: design 1b: a row no longer prints its open-draft link line — 'Edit' (workflow-open-<slug>) opens the workflow page, whose OPEN DRAFT card carries the draft, its editor and its status
workflows-filter-project: design 1b: the project <select> filter is replaced by the search field (workflows-search) plus the filter chips workflows-filter-all, workflows-filter-draft, workflows-used-in-<projectId> and workflows-filter-folder
threads-one-off-filter: design 1g: the 'one-off only' default is dropped — the thread list now filters with the chips threads-filter-all ('all projects'), threads-filter-mine and threads-filter-runs ('from runs') over the search field threads-search (Threads Review handoff)
studio-undo-mobile: 390 reflow: the phone header no longer duplicates undo/redo — the single studio-undo/studio-redo pair is visible at every width (ui/src/components/studio/StudioHeader.tsx)
studio-redo-mobile: 390 reflow: the phone header no longer duplicates undo/redo — the single studio-undo/studio-redo pair is visible at every width (ui/src/components/studio/StudioHeader.tsx)
validate-panel-milestone-*: copy-milestones: a W8 row no longer prints the internal build milestone the server names — the row's marker is validate-panel-deferred-* ('not available yet') and the server's own sentence stays as data-server-message on validate-panel-message-* (ui/src/components/m4/ValidatePanel.tsx)
run-nav-collapse: design run view (10): the run page has no runs list — the project's runs live on the project's Runs tab — so the inspector's left nav is the section rail alone and nothing collapses (ui/src/pages/RunInspector.tsx)
run-nav-expand: design run view (10): the collapsed 2.25rem rail existed only to restore the runs list the run page no longer mounts; the section rail is always shown (ui/src/pages/RunInspector.tsx)
project-conversations-title: design 1b (project-tabs-frame): the Threads tab is the shared header band + tab row now — the project's name is the page's H1 and the THREADS panel's title bar names the section, so the old page-level 'Threads — <project>' headline is gone (e2e/emulator/design.ts accepts project-conversations as the page landmark)
project-page-loading: design 1b (project-tabs-frame): still rendered at runtime — the overview's loading branch is now `ProjectFrame`'s, which builds the handle from the page's own testid (`${testid}-loading`), so the static scan cannot see the literal; Project.test.tsx still asserts the id
project-page-error: design 1b (project-tabs-frame): same as project-page-loading — computed by ProjectFrame from the page testid, asserted by Project.test.tsx
project-page-not-found: design 1b (project-tabs-frame): same as project-page-loading — the refusal branch's wrapper is computed by ProjectFrame; the refusal sentence itself keeps `project-not-found`
repo-workflow-edit-*: design 2e row actions (2026-10-30 review, 2e item 8): the workflow row's actions are `+ Add trigger` and `Run` — the row also carried an `Edit` link to the library workflow page that the workflow's own NAME already links to (identical href), so it was a duplicate affordance the artboard does not draw
repo-workflow-add-box-*: design 2e (2026-10-30 review, 2e item 6): a row carries ONE `+ Add trigger`, and `repo-workflow-add-*` is now the id of whichever copy is showing — the STARTS WHEN header's (the design's expanded row, which is also the default) or the row's own actions (the design's collapsed row). Nothing was lost at runtime; the box header's button kept the row id
